_comment: Who the fake hub accepts. A request without a bearer token or with one of rejectedTokens is 401 Unauthorized, like an expired or revoked token on the hub. Every other token is a user: one of deniedTokens gets allowed: false from SelfSubjectAccessReview and 403 Forbidden on managedclusters; any other token is allowed while defaultAllowed is true. serviceAccount is the identity bin/fake-kubeconfig gives the backend; it is allowed even when defaultAllowed is false. The console BFF sends its AUTH_TOKEN to the SelfSubjectAccessReview endpoint, so pick a token from this file to see the console as that kind of user. Converted from the console fixture directory's access.json; serviceAccount is added here.
